source_selection.identity_assessment: The catalog supplies only a proof-method label and a one-line Atiyah-Singer gloss. It does not determine operator class, manifold and bundle hypotheses, grading, coefficient and normalization conventions, boundary behavior, or which index-theorem conclusion is canonical.

retry_condition: Select and independently approve an immutable primary-source theorem, exact theorem/page and incorporated definitions, then freeze all domains, binders, hypotheses, normalization and boundary conventions before Lean encoding.
status_boundary: Fail-closed statement record only. Null canonical-target fields preserve a source-identity blocker; they do not define an abstract or weakened theorem.
